name: Feedly
tagline: RSS reader and research feed for websites, newsletters, and alerts

pricing.notes: Official docs checked 2026-07-30; Feedly Pro listed at $7/month or $65/year.

tiers.name: Pro
tiers.limits: Faster feed polling, search and integrations; annual total is $65.

tiers.name: Pro+
tiers.limits: AI Feeds, RSS Builder and Zapier; feed polling can be as frequent as 7 minutes.
tiers.notes: Annual-only, but the current exact public price was not exposed.

tiers.name: Enterprise
tiers.limits: Team feeds, administration and intelligence tools; numeric seat limits and price are quote-based.

pricing.billingTerms: Pro offers monthly + annual; Pro+ is annual-only; Enterprise is quote-based
pricing.hiddenCosts: self-service refunds are limited to 5 days after a charge; Enterprise cost scales by seats and selected intelligence features

verdictSummary: Core RSS reading, folders, search, and saved articles are very buildable; Feedly's paid moat is polished feed discovery, mobile, AI features, and reliability.
coreLoopDIY: Parse RSS feeds on a schedule, store items, mark read/saved, expose folders and search, and optionally summarize articles.
whyPeopleStillPay: They pay to avoid maintaining hundreds of feeds and reader apps across devices.

priorArt.name: FreshRSS
priorArt.desc: Mature self-hosted RSS aggregator and reader.

alternatives.name: Folo
alternatives.desc: A modern hosted research feed with 150 free subscriptions, one inbox and one automation.

alternatives.name: NewsBlur
alternatives.desc: Feeds, newsletters and trainable filters, in exchange for running several databases.

rejectedAlternatives.name: FreshRSS
rejectedAlternatives.desc: Excellent RSS, but it has no built-in email-newsletter inbox or alert workflow.

rejectedAlternatives.name: Miniflux
rejectedAlternatives.desc: A fine feed reader, but newsletters and monitoring require separate services.

notes: A textbook yes: open protocol, many mature open-source alternatives.
prompt:
Build me a personal RSS reader to replace Feedly. Requirements:

- Node + Express + better-sqlite3, server-rendered pages, binds to localhost.
- Feeds live in feeds.opml with folders; import my Feedly OPML export on first
  run so nothing is retyped.
- Poll every 30 minutes with node-cron, parse with rss-parser, dedupe items by
  GUID then link.
- Reader UI: unread counts per folder, an article list with j/k keyboard
  navigation, one-key mark-read, and s to star.
- Starred view, plus full-text search over titles and content via SQLite FTS5.
- Optional summarize button per article using an LLM key from .env; hide the
  button entirely when no key is set.
- Keep read items 90 days, starred forever, pruned nightly.
- No accounts, no telemetry, local-first.
- Out of scope: mobile apps and feed discovery/suggestions. Adding feeds means
  editing the OPML, that is fine.
- README: setup, where the DB lives, and how to export my OPML back out.
